name: Orchestrator Builder
description: Build and run an agent team graph.

tools.name: submit_report
tools.description: Submit the current orchestrator step report, optional review decision, and optional evidence-backed findings.

nonce.description: Exact step reference from the task.

report.description: Short human-readable report, at most 8192 bytes.

result.description: Decision for a conditional review step only.

findings.description: Up to four findings for the Team handoff.

summary.description: Short statement of the finding, at most 512 bytes.

evidence.description: Concrete supporting evidence, at most 1024 bytes.
